name: Animated_Armor
condition_immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
notes: CR 1. Construct. AC 18. HP 33. Multiattack: 2 Slam +4 (1d6+2 bludgeoning). Antimagic Susceptibility: incapacitated in antimagic field; Dispel Magic DC 13 STR or unconscious 1 min. False Appearance: motionless = indistinguishable from normal armor.
gm_notes: Session 4 Sunken Armory — divine resonance constructs, NOT undead. Spear-light activates 80-100yr old consecrated armor. No undead vulnerabilities apply. React to hesitation: decisive movement does not draw their attention. Laid in combat formation (two files, advance rank, reserve rank). A soldier who identifies the formation and calls it out grants advantage on first attack to anyone who follows the layout.
